_register_file_utilization: Scarab does NOT emit a single 'average RF utilization' counter. Every cycle it samples integer/vector physical RF occupancy and accumulates running totals. After simulation, read core.stat.0.csv (3rd column = cumulative total) and compute: int_rf_util_pct = 100 * REG_FILE_INT_OCCUPIED_SUM / REG_FILE_INT_PHYS_REGS_SUM; vec_rf_util_pct = 100 * REG_FILE_VEC_OCCUPIED_SUM / REG_FILE_VEC_PHYS_REGS_SUM. Requires Scarab built with hpca2027-characterization commit 7185dea5d (cherry-picked onto hpca2027-baseline). PARAMS.in already sets --reg_renaming_scheme 1 and --reg_table_integer_physical_size 280; no extra params needed in configurations.params. Workflow: ./sci --sim hpca2027/baseline → open core.stat.0.csv → divide the two INT sums (example: 24687935911 / 32597510400 ≈ 75.7%). For simpoint-weighted workload averages: ./sci --collect-stats hpca2027/baseline then apply the same ratio per row in collected_stats.csv.
